links.comparator_used: Ablated RAS pipeline variants (e.g., without structured clinical descriptors or without guideline retrieval) in a controlled ablation study
links.outcome: Overall report quality and numerical faithfulness (NumCov) of guideline-grounded reports; guideline coupling
links.effect: For LLaMA, the full RAS pipeline achieved the strongest overall performance, with NumCov 0.98±0.03 and consistent guideline coupling. Qwen frequently distorted simulation-derived numerical values and under-reported time in range by a mean of -10.6 percentage points.
links.tradeoff: Model-specific safety risks: Qwen distorted numerical values, under-reported time in range (-10.6 percentage points) and over-reported time below range, inflating hypoglycemia risk.
links.quote: For LLaMA, the full RAS pipeline achieved the strongest overall performance, maintaining high numerical faithfulness (NumCov: 0.98±0.03) and consistent guideline coupling.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with structured clinical descriptors (ablation)
